contributions.anchor: Form A's own printed 'Total Contributions: (to line 1 of report): 1,450.00', which equals the cover's line-1 CUMULATIVE cell (1,450.00)
contributions.detail: 3 Form A rows (1,000.00 + 300.00 + 150.00) sum to 1,450.00 = the schedule's own printed total = the cover's CUMULATIVE column, not its This-Report column. This schedule is CUMULATIVE-scoped: it restates the whole cycle (the two January self-funding lines predate this October-8 report's June-14-to-October-3 window), so `exact` is the right verdict and the cover's This-Report figure of 150.00 - which is exactly the one row dated 7/23/2024 - is NOT the matching-scope anchor. Cover arithmetic closes independently: 1,300.00 last + 150.00 this = 1,450.00. 3-line 2024 form, single contrib_all cell, no <=$50 aggregate line, so the line-1/line-2 basis rule does not apply. No in-kind line on the sheet, so both in-kind conventions give the same sum.

expenditures.anchor: Form B's own printed 'Total Expenditures: (to line 2 of report): 907.19', which equals the cover's line-2 CUMULATIVE cell (907.19)
expenditures.detail: 6 Form B rows (747.61 + 18.69 + 1.48 + 22.94 + 100.00 + 16.47) sum to 907.19 = the schedule's own printed total = the cover's CUMULATIVE column. Cumulative-scoped like Form A: five of the six lines predate this report's window and only the 10/2/2024 Smiths Food line (16.47) falls inside it - which is precisely the cover's This-Report cell, so the two scopes are both visible on the page and each closes on its own terms. Cover arithmetic closes independently: 890.72 last + 16.47 this = 907.19, and line 3 Ending Balance 1,450.00 - 907.19 = 542.81 as printed.

escalation_note: 6 tight --value crops at 900 dpi, all for GEOMETRY PROOF rather than legibility - both schedules are machine-TYPED and fully legible on the 200 dpi full page, and no cell was in dispute. 20.measure_note: ROTATED landscape sheet; rows advance LEFT-TO-RIGHT (axis x), so the printed ROW rules are the page's VERTICAL rules and the COLUMN bands are its horizontal ones. Row rules re-detected over the table's y-window (6-95 pct) at 35% coverage (rowbands.py's own vertical pass under-detects here): 7.12 binding bar, 9.47 table border, 12.71 label column, 15.76 = end of the grey shaded strip and start of the data grid, then a constant 2.94-3.24 pct pitch to 87.41. The 23 DATA bands stored here start at 15.76 - bar, border, label column and shaded strip are TRIMMED, so row N resolves to rows[N-1]. Column bands are the horizontal rules over x=15-88 at 90% coverage: 7.11 / 17.41 / 57.84 / 86.86 / 94.68 = Amount | Address | Name of Contributor | Date; `cell` is the AMOUNT band [7.11,17.41], confirmed by cropping it and getting figures rather than names. INDEXING PROOF (addendum A3): pct:15.76,7.11,3.12,10.30@p20 renders '1,000.00' = row 1's recorded amount, and pct:22.06,7.11,3.20,10.30@p20 renders '150.00' = row 3's (the LAST transcribed row) recorded amount.

21.measure_note: Same rotated geometry as p20 but a DIFFERENT origin - Form B's grid starts one band later.
